texts.preamble: Jitendra Jayantilal Rughani vs The Municipal Corporation Of Greater ... on 19 December, 2018 Bench: Ranjit More, Revati Mohite Dere 1/3 905&906-wp.2492.97.2018.doc nsc. In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Ordinary Original Civil Jurisdiction Writ Petition No.2492 Of 2018 Ramjanak Sukhram Jaiswal ...Petitioner Versus The Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai and Anr....Respondents With Writ Petition No.2497 Of 2018 Jitendra Jayantilal Rughani ...Petitioner Versus The Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai and Anr....Respondents Ms.S.N.Ghotekar, for the Petitioners in both the Petitions. Ms.K.H.Mastakar, for the Respondent - M.C.G.M. Coram : Ranjit More & Revati Mohite Dere, Jj. 2. The Petitioners in the above Petitions claim that they are selling cooked Vada Pav/Samosa/Pav/Bhajiya/Cutlet and Farsan 2/3 905&906-wp.2492.97.2018.doc respectively in a hawking zone viz Opposite Janseva Bank, Sector - 1, Near Charkop Market, Swami Samarth Kadsidheshwar Marg, Charkop, Kandivali (West), Mumbai - 400 067.
texts.facts: 2. The Petitioners in the above Petitions claim that they are selling cooked Vada Pav/Samosa/Pav/Bhajiya/Cutlet and Farsan 2/3 905&906-wp.2492.97.2018.doc respectively in a hawking zone viz Opposite Janseva Bank, Sector - 1, Near Charkop Market, Swami Samarth Kadsidheshwar Marg, Charkop, Kandivali (West), Mumbai - 400 067. Both the Petitioners claim that they are doing this business since last more that 15 years. The Petitioners also relied upon the respective Registration Certificates issued to them under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
